previous_statement: By the registered nonvanishing-delta-projection definition and e=delta+epsilon from def-hcb-datum, there are universal K_0<infinity and e_0>0 such that e<=e_0 implies ||Q||>=1-K_0*e.
new_statement: Conditional norm estimate only: if Q is nonvanishing in the sense of the registered nonvanishing-delta-projection definition, then there are universal K_0<infinity and e_0>0 such that e<=e_0 implies ||Q||>=1-K_0*e. The exact allowed inputs do not establish that the one-dimensional delta-projection Q in an H-CB datum is nonvanishing.
